tests.title: Host lookup order is Options.Host, then Env (empty falls through), then Getenv, then process env, then the default

the only key ever recorded is ollama.HostVar "OLLAMA_HOST"
tests.pseudocode: New(m, {Host:'h1', Getenv:spy}); assert spy.keys == []; New(m, {Env:{OLLAMA_HOST:''}, Getenv:spy}); assert spy.keys == ['OLLAMA_HOST']; assert Host()==DefaultHost when all empty

given: a recording server that streams text and a tool call then closes the body without done:true
an agent with a tool whose handler records invocations
tests.when: agent.Run is called
then: the run returns an error wrapping ollama.ErrStreamTruncated
the assistant message keeps the streamed text and carries no tool call
the tool handler was never invoked
